mainEntity.name: Can a GEO content strategy benefit an online-only business without a physical location?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, an online-only business can still benefit from a GEO content strategy, especially if its target customers are geographically concentrated or if it offers services specific to certain regions. While not driving foot traffic, a business might create content targeting problems specific to, for example, 'e-commerce solutions for Los Angeles businesses.' This helps attract local clients who prefer to work with businesses perceived as understanding their local market nuances, even if the service delivery is remote. It establishes local authority and relevance.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, online businesses can use GEO content strategy to target geographically concentrated customers or offer region-specific services. This builds local authority and relevance, even without a physical storefront.
